question: The total surface area of a solid hemisphere is 155 cm². Its radius (in cm) is ________. (Take π = (22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The total surface area of a solid hemisphere is given by 3πr².

Equating this to the given area directly:

3 × (22/7) × r² = 155

r² = (155 × 7) ÷ 66 = 1085/66

r = √(1085/66) cm

**∴ The correct answer is √(1085/66) cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total surface area of solid hemisphere = 155 cm²

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a solid hemisphere = 3πr²

 

 
 
• 
 
 r
 Flat Area = πr²
 Curved Area = 2πr²
 Total Surface Area = 155 cm²

**Calculations:**

⇒ 3 × π × r² = 155

⇒ 3 × (22/7) × r² = 155

⇒ (66/7) × r² = 155

⇒ r² = (155 × 7) ÷ 66

⇒ r² = 1085/66

⇒ r = √(1085/66) cm

**∴ The correct answer is √(1085/66) cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area of a Hemisphere

The curved surface area includes only the bowl-shaped part, excluding the flat base. Formula: CSA = 2πr².

Volume of a Hemisphere

The volume of a solid hemisphere is exactly half the volume of a full sphere. Formula: Volume = (2/3)πr³.

Total Surface Area of a Sphere

A complete sphere has only a curved surface with no flat edges. Formula: TSA = 4πr².
